name: Commodore Guff
description: Knew how the Phyrexian Invasion would end.

description_citations.text: "Bo Levar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar, Guff, Freyalise and Windgrace discover Urza's treachery and Taysir's death and decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.
timeline.quote: They decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining Nine Titans set off the last Soul Bomb, gutting Phyrexia, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally comes back to Dominaria, after 9000 years, in the form of a death cloud

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar convinces Guff, who erases Dominaria's dark destiny before the death cloud kills him.
timeline.quote: In his library he erases the dark destiny of Dominaria

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar gives his essence to shield the Eliterates from Yawgmoth's Black Cloud of Death and dies.
timeline.quote: He gave his life in appreciation of beauty
